# ParrotGPT

> > ParrotGPT provides comprehensive guides and tutorials on AI technologies, focusing on large language models, deep learning frameworks, and cloud computing platforms.

The site offers practical resources for developers and businesses looking to implement AI solutions, covering tools like TensorFlow, Keras, GPT models, and cloud platforms from Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and AWS. Content ranges from beginner tutorials to advanced implementation guides for NLP, chatbots, and business automation.

## Key Topics

- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- TensorFlow
- Keras
- Deep Learning Frameworks
- Business Automation
- ChatGPT and GPT-4
- Machine Learning
- Cloud Computing (Azure, GCP, AWS)
- AI Chatbots
- Neural Networks
- Python for AI
- Text-to-Speech
- AI Tools and Frameworks
- Bing AI

## Implementation Guides

- [Implementing LLM Apps: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://theparrotgpt.com/blogs/implementing-llm-apps): Step-by-step guide for implementing large language model applications
- [How to get started with TensorFlow: A step-by-step tutorial](https://theparrotgpt.com/blogs/how-to-get-started-with-tensor-flow): TensorFlow beginner tutorial with Keras for deep learning frameworks
- [How to build and deploy scalable models with Keras](https://theparrotgpt.com/blogs/how-to-build-and-deploy-scalable-models-with-keras): Keras model building and deployment guide with TensorFlow integration
